title: The Runaway Carousel
blurb: The carousel horses have galloped off into the night. Bring them home before the fair opens!

hooks.title: An Empty Carousel
text: The carousel spins with no horses on it.
Hoofprints of brass lead off toward {place}.

choices.label: Follow the hoofprints
choices.text: {hero} kneels by the prints. They are still warm!

choices.label: Ask for help
choices.text: {ally} whispers: {villain} wound them up and set them loose.

hooks.title: Music at Midnight
text: The carousel organ starts playing at midnight.
Then every horse jumps off and gallops away!

choices.label: Chase them now!
choices.text: Everyone runs after the clatter of brass hooves.

deed.text: chased the horses into the night

choices.label: Switch off the organ
choices.text: {hero} pulls the big lever. The music stops. The horses slow down.

beats.title: Splash at the Duck Pond
text: A brass horse is paddling round the duck pond.
The ducks are not happy about it.

callbacks.text: After {who} {deed}, the trail leads straight here.

choices.label: Wade in after it
choices.text: {hero} wades in, boots and all.

game.intro: Catch the horse before it swims off!

win.text: {winner} grabs the reins and leads the horse to dry land.

deed.text: pulled a horse out of the duck pond

lose.text: {loser} ends up with a duck sitting on their head.

deed.text: wore a duck as a hat

choices.label: Lure it with carrots
choices.text: {hero} waves a bunch of carrots. The horse sniffs the air.

game.intro: Toss the carrots right on target!

win.text: {winner} lands the perfect carrot. The horse trots out happily.

deed.text: tricked a horse with a carrot

lose.text: {loser} throws a carrot into the pond. A duck eats it.

beats.title: Lost in the Hay Maze
text: Neighing echoes from inside the hay maze.
Every path looks the same.

choices.label: Split up and search
choices.text: Everyone dives into a different tunnel of hay.

win.text: {winner} finds the horse munching hay in the middle.

lose.text: {loser} pops out of the maze covered in straw.

deed.text: came out of the maze looking like a scarecrow

choices.label: Climb on top
choices.text: From up high, {hero} spots the horse at once.

game.intro: Hop across the bales without falling!

win.text: {winner} leaps the last bale and lands right on the horse.

lose.text: {loser} slides down a bale like a slide. Wheee!

beats.title: Dodgem Stampede
text: Two brass horses are racing the dodgem cars!
They keep bumping into each other on purpose.

choices.label: Jump in a dodgem
choices.text: {hero} hops in a dodgem and stamps on the pedal.

game.intro: Bump your way to the horses!

win.text: {winner} herds both horses into the corner. Beep beep!

deed.text: rounded up two horses in a dodgem

lose.text: {loser} spins round and round in circles.

deed.text: spun in circles in a dodgem

choices.label: Cut the power
choices.text: The dodgems stop. The horses look around, confused.

game.intro: Grab the horses before they wake up!

win.text: Together you catch both horses while they are still dizzy.

lose.text: One horse slips away, but the other is caught.

beats.title: The Clockwork Guard
text: A clockwork guard stands at the gate, ticking loudly.
Behind it, three horses are tied to a post.

callbacks.text: Since {who} {deed}, the guard is ticking very slowly.

choices.label: Outrun it!
choices.text: Everyone takes a deep breath and gets ready to run.

win.text: {winner} outruns the guard and unties the horses.

lose.text: {loser} gets a gentle bonk on the head from the guard.

deed.text: was bonked by a clockwork guard

choices.label: Wind it backwards
choices.text: {hero} creeps up to the big key in its back.

game.intro: Turn the key in time with the ticks!

win.text: {winner} winds it down. The guard yawns and sits.

deed.text: wound the clockwork guard to sleep

lose.text: {loser} winds it the wrong way. It does a little dance.

beats.title: The Shooting Gallery
text: {villain} has hidden a horse's key in the shooting gallery.
Only a perfect shot will knock it loose.

choices.label: Take aim
choices.text: {hero} picks up a cork popper and squints.

win.text: PLINK! {winner} knocks the key into the air and catches it.

deed.text: shot the brass key off the shelf

lose.text: {loser} hits the bell, the lamp and a very surprised owl.

deed.text: startled an owl at the gallery

choices.label: Look for a trick
choices.text: {hero} notices the targets move in a pattern.

win.text: {winner} works out the pattern and lifts the key free.

lose.text: {loser} guesses wrong and gets a squirt of water.

beats.title: Ghost Train Tunnel
text: Hoofbeats rattle through the ghost train tunnel.
Paper bats flap in the dark.

choices.label: Ride the ghost train
choices.text: Everyone squeezes into one little cart. Off you go!

win.text: {winner} spots a horse hiding behind a cardboard ghost.

deed.text: found a horse on the ghost train

lose.text: {loser} screams so loudly that the cardboard ghost falls over.

choices.label: Turn on the lights
choices.text: {hero} finds the switch. The tunnel is not scary at all now.

win.text: {winner} collects the most horseshoes. A horse trots over to say thanks.

lose.text: {loser} trips over a rubber skeleton.

beats.title: Battle of the Bands
text: {villain} is playing a tuba on the bandstand.
Every horse that hears it dances away!

choices.label: Play louder!
choices.text: {hero} grabs a drum and starts bashing away.

win.text: {winner} drowns out the tuba. The horses stop dancing.

deed.text: out-played the tuba on the bandstand

lose.text: {loser} drums so wildly the drum rolls away.

deed.text: lost a drum down the hill

choices.label: Hide the sheet music
choices.text: {hero} sneaks up behind the music stand.

win.text: {winner} swaps the music for a shopping list. The tuba squeaks and stops.

deed.text: swapped the villain's music for a shopping list

lose.text: {loser} gets caught and has to sing a song.

beats.title: The Clockwork Workshop
text: The trail ends at {villain}'s workshop.
Gears whirr. Something big is being built inside.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so the workshop door clicks open.

extra.text: The rescued horses neigh. They want to help.

choices.label: Storm the door
choices.text: Everyone charges in together!

win.text: {winner} bursts through first and grabs the master key.

lose.text: {loser} gets tangled in a spring. Boing!

deed.text: got tangled in a giant spring

choices.label: Fix the machines
choices.text: {hero} rolls up both sleeves.

game.intro: Put the gears in the right order!

win.text: {winner} fixes the gears. The machines start building horse stables instead.

lose.text: {loser} builds a tiny clockwork mouse by accident. It is adorable.

deed.text: built a clockwork mouse by accident

beats.title: Top of the Ferris Wheel
text: The last horse is stuck at the very top of the Ferris wheel.
The wheel is turning faster and faster.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Climbing a wheel is nothing after that.

choices.label: Climb up
choices.text: {hero} starts climbing, one seat at a time.

game.intro: Hold on and dodge the swinging seats!

win.text: {winner} reaches the top and rides the horse down the spokes!

deed.text: rode a horse down the Ferris wheel

lose.text: {loser} gets dizzy and has to hug a seat for a while.

choices.label: Throw a rope
choices.text: {hero} ties a lasso from bunting.

win.text: {winner} lassos the horse and lowers it gently down.

deed.text: lassoed a horse off the Ferris wheel

lose.text: {loser} lassos a hot dog stand instead.

beats.title: The Big Stampede
text: Every runaway horse is galloping straight at the party!
{villain} is riding at the front.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, and the horses still remember the beat.

choices.label: Stand together
choices.text: Everyone links arms and plants their feet.

win.text: {winner} is the last one standing. The horses stop and stare.

deed.text: stood firm in the great stampede

lose.text: {loser} gets carried along on a horse's back for a while.

choices.label: Ring the dinner bell
choices.text: {hero} rings the bell at the hay barn. Dinner time!

win.text: {winner} fills the most buckets. Every horse stops to eat.

lose.text: {loser} spills a bucket of oats down their own shirt.

deed.text: wore a shirt full of oats

interludes.title: A Golden Horseshoe
text: A golden horseshoe glints in the grass.
It is still warm from galloping.

choices.label: Keep it for luck
choices.text: {hero} pockets the horseshoe. It hums softly.

choices.label: Hang it over the gate
choices.text: {hero} hangs it up. Luck for everyone!

deed.text: hung a lucky horseshoe for everyone

interludes.title: {ally} Waves
text: {ally} hurries over with a flask of cocoa.
"You look frozen! Have a sip."

choices.label: Sit for a minute
choices.text: Warm cocoa, warm hands. Everyone feels ready again.

choices.label: No time, run!
choices.text: {hero} gulps the cocoa on the move and dashes off.

deed.text: drank cocoa at a full sprint

climax.title: The Clockwork Colossus
text: {villain} climbs into a giant clockwork horse.
"No one rides my carousel but ME!"

callbacks.text: After {who} {deed}, you know its weak spots.

extra.text: The fixed machines whirr to help you!

choices.label: Fight it together
choices.text: Everyone gets ready. This is it!

win.text: The Colossus wobbles, clanks and falls apart! {villain} climbs out, sorry.

lose.text: The Colossus gallops off into the sunrise. It will be back.

choices.label: Race it round the fair
choices.text: {hero} shouts: "Bet you can't beat us round the fair!"

win.text: {winner} wins the race! {villain} hands back {prize}.

lose.text: {loser} takes a wrong turn into the candy floss tent.

deed.text: raced into the candy floss tent

climax.title: The Last Ride
text: {villain} has {prize}, the fastest horse of all.
It is galloping round the empty carousel ring.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. The other horses cheer you on.

choices.label: Hop on and catch up
choices.text: {hero} jumps onto the spinning carousel.

win.text: {winner} catches {prize}! The carousel music plays a happy tune.

lose.text: {loser} goes round and round and round.

choices.label: Stop the whole ride
choices.text: Everyone grabs the brake lever together.

win.text: The carousel stops. {prize} trots home to its pole.

lose.text: The brake snaps! {villain} rides off laughing.

any: The horses are home and the carousel spins again.
{villain} now sweeps the stables every morning.
Sunrise. Every horse is back on its pole.
The first ride of the day is free, thanks to you.
Most horses are home, but {prize} is still out there.
The carousel is quiet. {villain} got away this time.
But you saved the fair's music!

lines.text: The golden horseshoe now hangs over the carousel gate.
The clockwork machines build a brand-new stable.
